package.name: uavx_eval
package.description:
The observer. It watches simulator ground truth and reports what the vehicles actually did, and it holds uavx_eval.check, the provenance gate every run record has to pass before any number in it is quoted.
It sits outside the swarm on purpose. stage-1/architecture.md section 1 lets this package and the link layer read ground truth, and lets nothing else, which is why the metrics collector may measure coverage and separation while no swarm node may.
